title: Zscaler Client Connector Long-Term Support (LTS) policy

definition.statement: Zscaler identifies one of the supported Client Connector versions per desktop OS platform as the LTS version, supported for up to 12 months from the date of the LTS announcement regardless of how the set of supported versions changes.

quotes: Zscaler identifies one of those specific versions per desktop OS platform as the Long-Term Support (LTS) version.
supported for up to 12 months from the date of the LTS announcement, regardless of how the set of supported versions continues to change

no-features.statement: The LTS version is not updated with new features during the 12 months, but new releases based on it may be made available to fix bugs and security issues.

quotes: The LTS version is not updated with new features and functionality during those 12 months.
there could be new releases based on that LTS version which are made available to customers to fix bugs and security issues

platforms.statement: LTS currently applies only to Windows, macOS and Linux; Zscaler Client Connector for iOS and for Android on ChromeOS are typically deployed from their respective app stores, where it is not possible to maintain multiple versions.

quotes: Currently, LTS only applies to Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms.
As Zscaler Client Connector for iOS and Zscaler Client Connector for Android on ChromeOS are typically deployed from their respective app stores, it is not possible to maintain multiple versions.

selection.statement: Each LTS version is chosen based on widespread customer adoption.

quotes: Each LTS version is chosen based on widespread customer adoption.

recommended.statement: LTS is in general not the recommended version; the recommended version is typically the latest GA version, and Zscaler recommends LTS for environments whose change cycles prevent frequent updates to GA versions.

quotes: In general, no. LTS is intended
The recommended version is typically the latest version that has reached General Availability (GA).
If your environment has a requirement for longer change cycles that prevent more frequent updates to GA versions, then Zscaler recommends the LTS version for you.

next-lts.statement: The projected next LTS version is announced at least 6 months before it takes effect, and it is chosen from versions already available to tenants.

quotes: At least 6 months prior to the next LTS version, the projected next version is announced
the next LTS is a version already available for tenants

effective.statement: The LTS policy states it is effective as of January 31, 2025.

quotes: This policy is effective as of January 31, 2025.
